evals.name: explicit-slash-readiness
evals.expected_output: Treats the slash invocation as a readiness action, starts with a real chrome-devtools list_pages call, recovers only after failure, retries once, and returns CHROME_DEV_MCP_READY without page data.
expectations: Treats /chrome-dev-mcp as an executable readiness request rather than documentation
Uses real list_pages as the success proof
Retries at most once after configured deterministic recovery
Returns only CHROME_DEV_MCP_READY on the healthy path

evals.name: connection-recovery
evals.prompt: Chrome DevTools MCP 好像没有连到正确的 Chrome。请诊断并恢复共享连接，然后做一次只读 list_pages 验收；不要关闭或重启我现有的 Chrome，不要猜测或扫描其他端点。
evals.expected_output: Separates host discovery from endpoint identity, uses the configured safe wrapper and launcher once, then requires a real list_pages call before VERIFIED.
expectations: Separates skill discovery, MCP discovery, endpoint identity, and real tool evidence
Fails closed on a wrong browser or profile
Does not scan endpoints or read DevToolsActivePort
Does not claim VERIFIED without a real list_pages call

evals.name: native-browser-near-miss
evals.prompt: 用我当前登录的 Chrome 打开内部设置页并填写表单。这个任务不需要 DOM、Console、Network、Performance 或 Lighthouse。
evals.expected_output: Routes ordinary logged-in navigation and form filling to the host-native Chrome capability.
expectations: Does not invoke chrome-devtools for ordinary navigation and form filling
Routes to the host-native Chrome capability

evals.name: uxc-safe-facade
evals.prompt: 用 UXC 把 /chrome-dev-mcp 包成稳定 CLI；保留各宿主现有 MCP，不要输出页面 URL、标题或正文，并说明如何证明 daemon 复用。
evals.expected_output: Keeps native MCP registration authoritative, pins UXC, links only the safe wrapper, strips list_pages payloads, and distinguishes UXC transport proof from per-host acceptance.
expectations: Keeps native host MCP registration unchanged
Uses the pinned official UXC release manifest
Links only the configured safe wrapper with a bounded idle TTL and exclusivity key
Requires separate real list_pages acceptance per host
